tvShow.name: Love Story
tvShow.overview: An anthology of sweeping true love stories that captured the world’s attention.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: The pressure of the Kennedy name weighs on John; Carolyn impresses at Calvin Klein; an unlikely connection forms at a charity event.

episodes.name: The Pools Party
episodes.overview: John juggles his mother's waning health, his strained relationship with Daryl and his newfound feelings for Carolyn.

episodes.name: America's Widow
episodes.overview: After a family tragedy, John seeks comfort from Carolyn.

episodes.name: I Love You
episodes.overview: Carolyn struggles to assimilate into John's world; John discovers a secret.

episodes.name: Battery Park
episodes.overview: John asks an important question. Carolyn and John publicly feud.

episodes.name: The Wedding
episodes.overview: As press spreads of their altercation, John and Carolyn prepare for their big day. Ann voices her concerns.

episodes.name: Obsession
episodes.overview: Carolyn suffers the consequences of being a public figure; tensions rise between Carolyn and John's family.

episodes.name: Exit Strategy
episodes.overview: Tensions boil over after John and Carolyn discover devastating news.

episodes.name: Search and Recovery
episodes.overview: John and Carolyn fight to keep their relationship intact; the world watches as tragedy strikes.

seasons.name: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette
seasons.overview: Season 1 depicts the whirlwind courtship and marriage of John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette. What started out as a beautiful union for the young couple, widely regarded as American royalty, began to fray under the stress of the relentless microscope and navel gaze of tabloid media.
